themes.label: Promoting UN assessment of AI's SDG impact
themes.definition: Diplomatic initiative within the UN to institutionalize assessment of AI and rapid technological change on the 2030 Agenda.
themes.inclusion: Include references to sponsoring or promoting UN resolutions, reviews or assessments concerning AI.
themes.exclusion: Exclude national SDG institutional arrangements without an AI element.
themes.boundary_cases: Where the initiative is framed mainly around SDG outcomes, also code AI_DEVELOPMENT_SDGS.

examples.quote: promoted the annual assessment of the impact of rapid technological change, especially artificial intelligence, on the achievement of the 2030 Agenda

themes.label: AI's impact on the 2030 Agenda
themes.definition: Linking AI to the achievement of the Sustainable Development Goals.
themes.inclusion: Include passages connecting AI to the 2030 Agenda or SDG achievement.
themes.exclusion: Exclude generic sustainable-development commitments that do not mention AI.
themes.boundary_cases: The preceding sentence about national 2030 Agenda architecture has no AI content and is not coded on its own.

examples.quote: especially artificial intelligence, on the achievement of the 2030 Agenda

value.rationale: Mexico 2018 (split across two short passages) mentions AI only as the subject of a UN assessment initiative it promoted on technology's impact on the 2030 Agenda; the other passage has no AI content.
